scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC- Haryana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Safai Karamchari or a dependent of a Safai Karamchari

Applicant must produce a Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent issued by a government authority such as a gazetted officer, municipal elected member, gram panchayat pradhan, local revenue officer, cantonment officer or railway officer
Loan can be availed only once at either Diploma/Graduation level or Post‑graduation level, unless the course is an integrated program covering both levels
Applicant must have secured admission in a regular full‑time recognized professional/technical course in India or abroad
Applicants who secured admission before 01‑12‑2009 must not have availed an educational loan from any other institution
benefits_summary: Education loans up to ₹10 lakhs for studies within India and up to ₹20 lakhs for studies abroad, with repayment over 5 years after a 6‑month moratorium.
documents_required: Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent issued by a gazetted government authority
